programmes.d: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves; they experience one of America's most storied duck hunts.

Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the Coues deer, known to hunters as the Grey Ghost; they test their skill and patience pursuing one of North America's most challenging big game animals.
The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest.
Join Tyler Jordan, Brandon Sheppard and Brantley Richardson as they hit the woods in Georgia during the peak of the November rut! Then, Tyler heads to Kansas in search of big Midwestern bucks.
The crew heads out to work on controlling the doe population and come across a huge 8-pointer.
Michael Pitts is joined by competition caller and call-maker Anthony Virga, as well as Cole Barthel; it's the first hunt of the year for the Realtree Road Trips crew.

Tyler Jordan is hunting with Turkeys for Tomorrow sweepstakes winners Jaryd and Kelli Hurst; Kelli is after her first turkey and just needs a little luck; Ole Miss Athletic Director Keith Carter also makes a visit to Realtree Farms to hunt.
After a tough go at it in Oklahoma, Rigsby Stewart gets back to his home turf in East Georgia.
Realtree's Ben McDonald gets lucky again on his first sit in Nebraska; this time he rattles in an absolute big whitetail into Bow Range.

In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds.

In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

What happens to the elephants when an area reaches carrying capacity? Dan Cabela investigates the growing problem, visiting Zimbabwe, Namibia and Angola to explore the future of elephant conservation.
Andy visits the land of Scotland; he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette.
Andy and his son, Logan, visit the country of New Zealand; they explore vineyards, helicopter hunts and more.

When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it's time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43' custom ACI Catamaran Killer Bee.

Capt. Justin Leake joins some old friends aboard the Fall Line in hopes of scoring big in the Bay Point Billfish Open. The trip will test the limits of all the anglers as the captain and crew do the impossible in hopes of bringing home the prize.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor launch out of Key Largo and fish their way up a creek filled with monsters.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Captain Tony Young for a day of offshore fishing and free diving out of Islamorada, Fla.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head deep into the Everglades to target snook in the murky waters of Lake Ingraham.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor use Lowrance Active Target all day to locate fish, first targeting bridge tarpon, followed by unearthing a variety of species in Florida Bay's mullet muds.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor chase tarpon of all sizes around Florida Bay and throughout the Everglades.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor catch spotted sea trout and jacks on the grass flats and potholes of Florida Bay.

Randy is in Oklahoma at the Dirty Bird ranch trying to take down a buck with his new Thompson Center Muzzleloader.
Mark Kayser reveals the secrets to building and positioning mock scrapes to outsmart mature bucks and orchestrate the ultimate whitetail setup.
Dan Schmidt sits down with Adam Hays to discuss the key strategies he uses to tag trophy-class whitetails year after year, from the U.S. to Canada.
